title: Xlab Group
description: xlab-group.com Xlab Group is an Egyptian creative and technology holding founded in 2000 in Alexandria by Samer Mady and Emad Rafla, built on the mix of art and technology. It unites three companies, Xlab iT Solutions, Xlab Advertising with a 2000 square meter signage factory, and Xlab Software, plus studios for animation and video, with offices in Alexandria, Cairo Smart Village and Boston, USA. With about 72 employees and roughly 3.9 million dollars revenue, it has branded 2500 shops, produced 55000 square meters of outdoor signs, run 135 campaigns and managed 35 million dollars in online ad spending for 1650 clients. Blue chip clients include BASF, Orange, Schneider Electric and Marseilia Group, a partnership lasting over 10 years. Xlab Software builds its own products, an ERP suite, payroll, POS chain management and a shipping certificate system, plus 165 published websites. Recent growth focuses on Saudi Arabia real estate accounts like RAFAL and AkamAlrajhi and US market.
